radiusSource: Radius 0.38 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Kaye et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-270 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.510.5464K/abstract): 264,366 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.386 +/- 0.008 solar masses from Kaye et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-270 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.510.5464K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3506 +/- 70 K from Kaye et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-270 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.510.5464K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
